project_type: AgentCore rewrite of mahalo-dock: Strands Agents SDK agent (agent/) + four mock-service AWS Lambdas (tools-lambdas/) + Python CDK IaC (infra-cdk/). Next.js frontend and thin API are out of scope for Task 4.
build_system: No central build. Lambdas are plain Python packaged by CDK from ../tools-lambdas; the agent is a plain Python package run with `python -m agent.chat`. CDK app is infra-cdk/app.py (cdk synth/deploy).
test_framework: pytest. Lambda tests use moto (@mock_aws) via tools-lambdas/tests/conftest.py. Agent tests under agent/tests. CDK tests use aws_cdk.assertions.Template under infra-cdk/tests.
build_command: cd infra-cdk && cdk synth --all   (offline, no AWS creds)
test_command: cd tools-lambdas && python -m pytest tests -q  ;  python -m pytest agent -q  ;  cd infra-cdk && python -m pytest tests -q

contribution_requirements: Keep behavioral docstrings/rules (repo-NAME discipline, dev-id resolution, UPDATE-vs-CREATE, github 'already exists'=success, propose/approve on writes). Equivalence is DATA-level (GATEWAY tools return JSON; the model re-formats), not byte-for-byte text. Keep the frozen files frozen (list below).
key_patterns: Lambda handler: `_get_router()` builds Store+Router once; `lambda_handler` wraps `store.ensure_seeded()` + `router.dispatch(event)` in try/except ClientError->error(503) / Exception->error(500) (see tools-lambdas/github/handler.py). Router normalizes Function-URL-v2 / API-GW events only; a Gateway Lambda-target event is a FLAT args map with the tool name on context.client_context.custom['bedrockAgentCoreToolName'] formatted '<target>___<tool>' and NO HTTP fields â€” so it 404s without an adapter (investigation section 3). Routes return {statusCode, headers, body(JSON string)} and enforce a static X-API-Token via common/auth.py::require_token. agent/tools/http.py::make_request treats ONLY statusCode in (200,201) as success, else returns {'error': f'Request failed with status {code}: {text}'}. Local @tool name == function name (strands/tools/decorator.py). Native BeforeToolCallEvent interrupt fires for MCP tools too (approval.py WriteApprovalHook); it currently exact-matches tool names so it must strip the Gateway '___' prefix. MCPClient is a ToolProvider passed into Agent(tools=[...]) and is only live inside its `with` context manager; construct-but-don't-start is offline-safe.
